text: Meeting new people actually energizes me.
After a day full of people, I need time alone to recharge.
I'm drawn to new possibilities and ideas more than familiar ways of doing things.
I trust concrete, practical information more than abstract ideas.
When deciding whether to keep or toss something, I lead with logic — efficiency and function.
I have a hard time letting go of things because of the memories or feelings attached to them.
I like making plans and keeping things organized in a set, predictable way.
I like moving spontaneously and adapting flexibly as things come up.
